main_body: Market stall: striped awning on top, a back shelf with produce, and a wooden counter with a front panel face and a stone base.
top_band: Counter top at rows 26-29 (highlight #b77541 at row 26, then mid-brown L=98 at rows 27-29), lighter than the front face below (L=49-65). Produce stands on it.
evidence: The column scan at x=16 reads awning (rows 2-10), back shelf (12-25), a counter top band (26-29), then a darker front face (30-40, L about 49) and a stone base. The step from L=98 to L=49 is more than 25 L, so the top band is distinct. It is about 4 rows, with a highlight row at the back edge and produce sitting on it. The darker row under the edge gives a slight eave shadow. The front panels are flat with only a central seam, so recessed_front is false. The construction matches the Beodeul stall references, which read the same way, so it passes.

style.evidence: The candidate has 37 colours and a median of 20 per tile, against 17 and 20 for the references. Flat-fill coverage is 13%, equal to the cheese stall. Only 1% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are tinted (dark brown beside wood, dark green beside leaves). The awning has several greens and cream stripes, and the wood has grain and speckle. The front panel is somewhat plain but matches the reference stalls in craft.
